notes.title: Mutations Update
notes.content:
Check out the full post on the Early Access version.

Full patch notes:
[list]
[*] First mutation

[*] Some enemies are more likely to have

notes.title: Playtest Update - March, 7th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44878632/692c87a8f5a5e2994f11432ac37153e0f6e0c14f.png[/img]

[h1]Organization progression system[/h1]
As a new member of the Balosian Legions (named after their leader, Duras Balos), you will have to ascend through the ranks to unlock more benefits and opportunities.

This new system is meant as both a [i]gentle[/i] guide and another progression layer.
With it, two new resources have been introduced: 
[list]
[*] Ballads are awarded after completing special missions (not being awarded yet); they are required for higher promotions
[*] Discords that are reprimands given when failing special missions (and on other occasions); they will prevent promotions in the future and can cause a game over under certain conditions (but not yet)
[/list]

The requirements of the first rank promotion refer to two new types of missions, duties and spars, which will be added during another update.

[h2]Complete list of change notes[/h2]
- New organization progression system!
- Various visual changes
- Added various UI sounds

notes.title: Change notes for Feb 16 Playtest Update
notes.content:
Complete list of changes:
[list]
[*] added a "Randomize All" button on the character creation screen; you can still use randomize on the individual character parts too;
[*] fixed a visual glitch in the turn order display in combat
[*] fixed flickering of the cards popup in character details->training
[*] fixed popups and tooltips not displaying over the right element, or staying open when they shouldn't
[*] disabled target framerate as it was causing a tearing effect on certain animations; we'll have it as a graphics setting in the future as currently it's impacting CPU usage negatively
[/list]
